meta.rule: A complete track means only that its bounded positive slice balances. Silence, zero results and omitted categories never establish absence or historical completeness.

localGaps.reason: The retained tw-locale results and TWHK set-symbol assets establish Traditional-Chinese card identities but do not distinguish Taiwan from Hong Kong distribution records.
localGaps.retryCondition: Register a positive Hong Kong product, distribution, or specimen record before assigning market provenance separately from the shared Traditional-Chinese edition.

localGaps.reason: No retained source-first card or product index independently enumerates English-language physical products distributed in Southeast Asia.
localGaps.retryCondition: Register a bounded SEA-English source carrying positive physical product or distribution identifiers; never reuse WEST English rows by language alone.
